stock_movements_type_direction.name: stock_movements_type_direction
stock_movements_type_direction.value:
("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'receipt' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'write_off' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'inventory_count')
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'sale' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'sale_cancellation' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'sale_return' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0)

stock_movements_command_metadata_complet.name: stock_movements_command_metadata_complete
stock_movements_command_metadata_complet.value:
(
          "stock_movements"."command_id" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_version" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."occurred_on" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_index" = 0
        )
        OR (
          "stock_movements"."command_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_version" >= 1
          AND "stock_movements"."occurred_on" IS NOT NULL
        )

stock_movements_inventory_count_payload_.name: stock_movements_inventory_count_payload_valid
stock_movements_inventory_count_payload_.value:
(
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'inventory_count'
          AND "stock_movements"."command_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."occurred_on" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."expected_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."expected_version" >= 0
          AND "stock_movements"."physical_quantity" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."physical_quantity" >= 0
          AND (
            "stock_movements"."valuation_unit_cost" IS NULL
            OR "stock_movements"."physical_quantity" > 0
          )
        )
        OR (
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'inventory_count'
          AND "stock_movements"."expected_version" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."physical_quantity" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."valuation_unit_cost" IS NULL
        )

stock_movements_receipt_cost_and_command.name: stock_movements_receipt_cost_and_command_required
stock_movements_receipt_cost_and_command.value:
"stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'receipt'
        OR (
          "stock_movements"."unit_cost" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."command_id" IS NOT NULL
        )

stock_movements_unit_cost_allowed.name: stock_movements_unit_cost_allowed
stock_movements_unit_cost_allowed.value:
"stock_movements"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR (
          "stock_movements"."unit_cost" >= 0
          AND scale("stock_movements"."unit_cost") <= 6
          AND "stock_movements"."unit_cost" < 1000000000000000000
        )

stock_movements_write_off_reason_valid.name: stock_movements_write_off_reason_valid
stock_movements_write_off_reason_valid.value:
(
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'write_off'
          AND "stock_movements"."reason_code" IS NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."reason_note" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'write_off'
          AND "stock_movements"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_movements"."reason_code" IN (
            'damaged', 'expired', 'lost', 'stolen', 'internal_use', 'other'
          )
          AND (
            "stock_movements"."reason_note" IS NULL
            OR (
              "stock_movements"."reason_note" = btrim(
                "stock_movements"."reason_note",
                
  ' ' || chr(9) || chr(10) || chr(11) || chr(12) || chr(13) ||
  chr(160) || chr(5760) ||
  chr(8192) || chr(8193) || chr(8194) || chr(8195) || chr(8196) ||
  chr(8197) || chr(8198) || chr(8199) || chr(8200) || chr(8201) ||
  chr(8202) || chr(8232) || chr(8233) || chr(8239) || chr(8287) ||
  chr(12288) || chr(65279)

              )
              AND btrim(
                "stock_movements"."reason_note",
                
  ' ' || chr(9) || chr(10) || chr(11) || chr(12) || chr(13) ||
  chr(160) || chr(5760) ||
  chr(8192) || chr(8193) || chr(8194) || chr(8195) || chr(8196) ||
  chr(8197) || chr(8198) || chr(8199) || chr(8200) || chr(8201) ||
  chr(8202) || chr(8232) || chr(8233) || chr(8239) || chr(8287) ||
  chr(12288) || chr(65279)

              ) <> ''
              AND char_length("stock_movements"."reason_note") <= 500
            )
          )
          AND (
            "stock_movements"."reason_code" <> 'other'
            OR "stock_movements"."reason_note" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
